meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以帮你把消息渠道(Telegram、Slack、WhatsApp 等)接到指定的 agent 分组,设置会话隔离级别、新增渠道分组、调整或查看接线。首次配置且尚无 agent 分组时,会引导你先运行 /init-first-agent。
howto.when: 在刚接入新渠道、搭建初期,或想单独重新配置渠道与 agent 分组的对应关系时,可以请它处理。

say.text: 现在哪些渠道已经接好,哪些还没配置?
say.note: 它会汇总显示当前配置。

say.text: 把 Slack 频道从旧 agent 组换到新 agent 组。
say.note: 它会删除旧接线并新建一条。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can wire messaging channels (Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, etc.) to agent groups, set conversation isolation levels, add channel groups, and adjust or review wiring. If no agent group exists yet, it directs you to run /init-first-agent first.
howto.when_en: It is used right after adding a channel, during initial setup, or standalone to reconfigure how channels map to agent groups.

say_en.text: Wire this Telegram group to the agent in folder A using shared session mode.
say_en.note: It will create the wiring with the chosen isolation option.

say_en.text: Which channels are wired and which are not configured?
say_en.note: It will summarize the current setup.

say_en.text: Move the Slack channel from the old agent group to the new one.
say_en.note: It will delete the old wiring and create a new one.
